styling_and_css_variables.instructions_to_main_agent: Completely remove the old 'clay-card', 'clay-inset', 'clay-chip', 'btn-clay' classes. Replace them with the modern, luxury, minimal glass styles defined below. The goal is a highly professional, dark-mode fintech aesthetic. Remove the scrolling market ticker marquee and the Next.js dev badge.
styling_and_css_variables.background_gradient: Apply a fixed, professional, subtle background gradient to the main wrapper to achieve the requested 'black and lime gradient' solid style: 'bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#132600] via-[#020302] to-[#020302]'. It should feel dark and premium, not overpowering.

components.glass_card: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.08] hover:border-[#ccff00]/40 transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
components.button_primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#b3e600] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-all rounded-full px-8 py-3 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.2)]
components.button_secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 hover:border-white/40 active:scale-95 transition-all rounded-full px-8 py-3

navbar.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#020302]/80 border-b border-white/10
navbar.content: Keep Logo image + 'Vertex AI' text. Links: Features, How it works, Pricing, Support. Primary CTA: 'Get Vertex AI' -> /login. Include mobile hamburger menu that opens a solid #020302 background overlay.

hero.structure: Centered vertical layout with massive padding (py-32).
elements: H1: 'Trade with Intelligence. Win with Vertex AI.' (Massive, tracking-tighter)
Buttons: Primary 'Get Vertex AI' and Secondary 'View Pricing' centered in a row.

Hero Card: A minimal, wide glass card positioned directly below. It ONLY contains the animated SVG candlestick chart with the floating 'BUY' marker and the bottom caption 'Powered by Vertex AI real-time algorithm'.
CRITICAL REMOVALS: Strip out the 'AI Signal Engine v4.2' badge. Strip out the 'Vertex Neural Core / Live scanning markets / 98.6% signal accuracy' header block from the card.

stats_row.structure: Grid of 4 items (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) with generous spacing (py-12).
stats_row.style: Data points should have massive numbers in Lime (#CCFF00) and small uppercase labels in Zinc-400.

features.structure: Bento-style or 3-column dense grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) gap-6. Add generous padding inside cards (p-8).
features.style: Use the glass_card style. Lucide icons must be colored in Lime (#CCFF00).

how_it_works.structure: 3 items. Use a horizontal grid (md:grid-cols-3) or a vertical timeline approach.
how_it_works.style: Use large faint numbers (e.g., text-white/5) positioned absolutely in the background of the card, with clean foreground text.

pricing.structure: 2 side-by-side cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2) gap-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto.
pricing.free_plan: Standard glass card style. Buttons: 'Create Quotex Account' and 'Contact Admin' (secondary style).
pricing.paid_plan: Highlight card: Use a solid Lime border border-[#ccff00]/50, a subtle lime inner glow, and 'Purchase License' button in primary lime style.

cta_band.structure: py-24 text-center. Large H2 'Start your trading career with Vertex AI'.
cta_band.style: Dark container with a radial lime spotlight bg behind the text. Button: 'Create free account' -> /registration in primary lime style.

footer.style: py-12 border-t border-white/10 text-sm text-zinc-500. Flex layout for logo, Privacy Policy, Support, disclaimer, copyright.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must have explicit hover states (color change + slight scale). Cards should have border highlight transitions on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Use Framer Motion to stagger-fade-in sections (initial={ opacity: 0, y: 20 }, whileInView={ opacity: 1, y: 0 }).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use standard Inter font for headers; strictly use the imported 'Outfit' font.
Do NOT center align the entire App container; only center-align specific sections like Hero and CTA band.
All interactive elements (buttons, links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky/fixed overlays; always use bg-[color]/[opacity] with backdrop-blur.
Ensure the design remains responsive, adapting gracefully from mobile (px-4, grid-cols-1) to desktop.
